## Hardware specifications
- **LED chip:** RGBIC-RD (RGBIC with discrete-die addressing)
- **Color rendering:** 16 million
- **Pattern presets:** 200+
- **Lifespan:** 50,000+ hours
- **Weather rating:** IP67
- **Operating temperature:** -40°F to 140°F
- **Smart home compatibility:** Alexa, Google Home, Control 4, Nice Elan

## Services (full)

### Permanent Outdoor Lights
URL: https://twilightzonelighting.com/permanent-outdoor-lights
From $950. Primary keyword: "permanent outdoor lights".
Aluminum-track LED systems mounted under your eaves — 16 million colors, app-controlled, invisible by day. One install. Beautiful for life.
Permanent outdoor lights are the most significant residential exterior upgrade of the past decade. A continuous aluminum track — color-matched to your trim — houses individually-addressable RGBIC-RD LEDs that produce all 16 million colors and 200+ patterns. Once installed, the system is essentially invisible by day and unforgettable by night.

URL: https://twilightzonelighting.com/permanent-christmas-lights

Permanent Christmas lights replace the annual ritual of climbing ladders, untangling string lights, and renting installers every November. Our system is mounted permanently under your eaves and color-matched to your trim — invisible by day, then auto-scheduled to display red-and-green for Christmas, orange-and-purple for Halloween, red-white-and-blue for July 4th, and 200+ other patterns all year.

## How a Twilight Zone install runs (5 steps)

1. **Free quote in 24 hours.** We measure linear feet, identify ladder access, propose track color, and quote in writing on the spot. No phone-tag, no upsells.
2. **Design + track color.** Match your existing trim — white, bronze, brown, or black. 3D rendering for HOA submission included free.
3. **Install in a day.** Single-story homes finish in 6–8 hours. W-2 crew, in-house. No subcontractors.
4. **Wiring + control box.** Concealed channel-routed wiring. One drop to the attic. Weatherproof box mounted in your garage. Surge protection inline.
5. **App + walkthrough.** We pair the controller with your Wi-Fi, train you on scenes and schedules, and don't leave until you've changed colors from your phone.
